author: V. H. Black
title: Congressman John McGuire highlights local healthcare expansion and national recognitions in early May tweets
text:
Congressman John McGuire, who represents Virginia’s 5th Congressional District, posted a series of messages on his Twitter account between May 5 and May 6, 2026, highlighting local events and national observances.
On May 5, McGuire recognized the role of small businesses in American society. In his post he stated, “For 250 years, small businesses have been at the core of America’s strength, giving generations the opportunity to build, grow, and achieve the American Dream. During National Small Business Week, we celebrate the entrepreneurs whose hard work drives our economy and keeps our” (May 5, 2026).
Later that day, McGuire attended an event for Centra’s new Behavioral Health Facility in Central Virginia. He wrote: “Today, I joined Centra for the ribbon cutting of its new Behavioral Health Facility. Purchased as part of Centra’s modernization plan, this 60,000-square-foot, 72-bed facility will expand access to critical services for the Central Virginia community. It will replace the current” (May 5, 2026). The opening of this facility is part of Centra’s ongoing efforts to modernize healthcare infrastructure in the region.
On May 6, McGuire marked National Nurses Day by expressing appreciation for nurses’ contributions. He posted: “Happy National Nurses Day!
Thank you to all the nurses who bring both expertise and empathy to the bedside every single day.” (May 6, 2026).
National Small Business Week is an annual event that recognizes small business owners’ impact on economic growth and job creation across the United States. Similarly, National Nurses Day is observed each year on May 6 to honor nurses’ dedication and essential role in healthcare.
Centra is a nonprofit healthcare system serving central and southern Virginia communities with hospitals and specialized care facilities.
